name: MinerBot / PipeGuard
subtitle: AI-Powered Sewer & Mine Inspection Robot
statusNote: STATUS NEEDS CONFIRMATION FOR LIVE FIELD DEPLOYMENT
problem: Hazardous underground sewer lines and mining tunnels present fatal risks to human workers due to toxic gas accumulation (methane, CO), high heat zones, and undetected structural blockages.
solution: Built an edge-AI enabled subterranean inspection rover equipped with a Raspberry Pi Zero 2W, Arduino Uno, MLX90640 thermal camera, and atmospheric sensors. Features a custom Flask dashboard with multi-threaded video streaming and sensor telemetry.
contribution: Led Team RoboLyte; designed system wiring and dual-microcontroller architecture (Pi Zero 2W + Arduino), developed the Flask real-time telemetry streaming server, and formulated the wired-tether communication protocol.
recognition: Finalist (14th place), Makers Conclave 2026 Physical AI Challenge (NIAT Hyderabad); submitted to Smart India Hackathon 2026 (SIH26039, Govt of Jharkhand mine-rescue rover).
architecture: Edge sensors read via Arduino ADC -> Serial interface to Raspberry Pi Zero 2W -> Local Python Flask daemon -> Multi-threaded thermal matrix and telemetry streaming to operator workstation.

name: Maggieaurcode Production Web Systems
subtitle: Commercial Client Sites & AI Stone Advisor
problem: Regional commercial businesses in Kota needed high-performance digital presence with customer discovery tools tailored to complex product inventories.
solution: Co-founded web studio delivering live production websites. Architected a Gemini-powered 'AI Stone Advisor' for K.V Stone for natural stone specification and quotation matching. Developed responsive business platforms for Kota Furniture Hub and Prakash Sports.
contribution: Co-founder and lead engineer; handled client discovery, frontend implementation, Gemini API integration for stone advisory logic, and deployment pipelines.
recognition: Finalist (Team Leader), BRAVE Entrepreneurship Accelerator (Apr–Jul 2026, NIAT).
architecture: Static frontends deployed on Vercel/Netlify communicating with serverless endpoints orchestrating Google Gemini API prompts for contextual product recommendations.

name: Usage Metering & Billing Engine
subtitle: High-Throughput Metering & Stripe Integration
problem: SaaS API infrastructures need robust, tamper-resistant usage metering and idempotent payment gateway synchronization to prevent overbilling or loss of service access.
solution: Engineered a production-ready usage metering and billing backend in Python/FastAPI integrated with Stripe API in test mode. Implemented token-based authentication, CRUD database routines on SQLite and PostgreSQL, and a polite rate-limited web scraper.
contribution: Sole backend developer for capstone engine; built database schemas, Stripe webhook handlers, usage ledger counters, and an AI Fluency portfolio featuring a Claude agent prompt ladder.
recognition: Successfully completed Backend AI Engineering & AI Fluency tracks (1 Jul – 16 Oct 2026).
architecture: Client API calls intercepted by FastAPI middleware -> Token authentication & rate counter -> PostgreSQL ledger persistence -> Asynchronous Stripe subscription sync.

name: NetraFlow
subtitle: Multi-Camera Vehicle Re-Identification
problem: Standard number-plate recognition (ANPR) systems fail in dense Indian mixed traffic due to high occlusion, non-standard plates, and identical vehicle models.
solution: Designed a plate-free vehicle re-identification framework that correlates visual feature vectors and spatial-temporal constraints across non-overlapping surveillance feeds to estimate origin-destination traffic flow.
contribution: Co-designed vehicle feature extraction pipeline, edge-case analysis for near-identical vehicles, and interactive 3D demonstration for hackathon jury.
recognition: Presented at Hypnexis 26 (36-hour hackathon, Manipal University Jaipur, 24–25 Oct 2026).
architecture: Simulated multi-camera video ingest -> Deep visual attribute vectorization -> Spatio-temporal transition probability filter -> Graph-based origin-destination matrix.

name: TalentLens
subtitle: AI-Based Candidate Ranking System
problem: Keyword-matching applicant tracking tools suffer from keyword-stuffing exploits and fail to measure true semantic qualification.
solution: Developed an AI recruitment platform that computes semantic-similarity embeddings between applicant portfolios and job descriptions, providing weighted competence scores.
contribution: Conducted codebase audit, resolved critical scoring-pipeline calibration errors, and integrated semantic ranking API routines.
recognition: Built and presented at India Runs 2026 Hackathon (Redrob AI / Hack2Skill).
architecture: Resume parsing -> Vector embedding generation -> Cosine similarity distance matrix -> Multi-factor normalization engine.

name: HydraControl
subtitle: Smart Remote Water Supply & Monitoring
problem: Unmonitored municipal and agricultural water supply pipelines experience unnoticed line breaches, turbidity contamination, and excessive power draw.
solution: Architected an IoT water control system combining an Android control application, a 3D functional prototype, and an ESP32 sensor node with ultrasonic level, turbidity, flow rate, and energy monitoring.
contribution: Android control interface development, sensor calibration equations, and hardware circuit schematics for SSR relay valve switching.
recognition: Built for IEEE Hackathon competition; Android app and 3D prototype delivered, hardware sensor deployment ongoing.
architecture: ESP32 micro-controller -> Sensor sampling (Flow/Turbidity/Ultrasonic) -> Wireless command receiver -> Solid-state relay valve actuator.

name: LedgerLens
subtitle: Crypto Fund Tracing & VASP Attribution
problem: Cryptocurrency laundering schemes use complex multi-hop transaction trees through unverified mixers and virtual asset service providers (VASPs) to obscure fraud proceeds.
solution: Authored the Problem & Solution Design Report for cryptographic fund flow tracing and VASP attribution heuristics under problem statement SIH26183 (Ministry of Home Affairs).
contribution: Researched multi-hop blockchain graph algorithms, exchange deposit address clustering patterns, and formulated attribution workflow documentation.
recognition: Smart India Hackathon 2026 Entry (SIH26183, Ministry of Home Affairs).
architecture: Ledger node indexing -> UTXO/Account graph reconstruction -> Heuristic clustering -> VASP attribution verification.

name: LoopLogic
subtitle: AI-Driven E-Commerce Reverse-Logistics Platform
problem: E-commerce return processing is heavily manual, leading to high shipping emissions, slow triage, and high product write-off rates.
solution: Co-authored an IEEE-format research paper proposing an automated reverse-logistics system that grades returned items, dynamically decides resell/refurbish/recycle pathways, and guarantees lifecycle auditability via Digital Product Passports.
contribution: Researched reverse-logistics routing algorithms, wrote the grading criteria section, and designed the Digital Product Passport data model.
recognition: VGU Technology Development Program (TDP 2026–27) Research Output.
architecture: Item return telemetry -> Computer vision defect grading -> Optimization engine (Resell / Refurbish / Recycle) -> DPP ledger update.
